About This Auction

Updated Country Home on 8.5± Acres Near Galena, Kansas Enjoy country living with the convenience of being close to town! Located on the west edge of Galena, Kansas, this property is going up for online-only auction September 11, 2026!   This nicely updated 3-bedroom, 1-bath home sits on approximately 8.5 acres with paved blacktop frontage and plenty of room to enjoy the outdoors. A covered front sitting porch overlooks the spacious yard with mature shade trees, creating a comfortable place to relax and enjoy the country setting. The property features a large barn with horse stalls along with a fenced pasture area ready for horses or other livestock. Previous owner put wood chips down for the horses feet. A large driveway provides plenty of room for trailers, equipment, and additional parking. The home also features a new heating and air conditioning unit, while the acreage offers plenty of outdoor space with the occasional deer passing through. Property highlights: 3 bedrooms and 1 bathroom 8.5± acres Nicely updated home New heating and A/C unit Large barn with horse stalls Fenced pasture area for livestock Paved/blacktop frontage Covered front sitting porch Large yard with mature shade trees Spacious driveway and parking area Occasional deer and wildlife Located on the west edge of Galena Approximately 20 minutes from Joplin, Missouri Online-only auction September 11, 2026 A great opportunity for anyone looking for a country home with acreage, room for animals, and useful improvements while still being within an easy drive of Joplin. Give Jamie Reister a call with any questions!
